from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # Three most frequent colors form the noisy background; the remaining
    # colors are the solid foreground figures. Return a 3x3 swatch of the
    # largest figure by area.
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = {color for color, _ in counts.most_common(3)}
    figure_colors = [color for color in counts if color not in background]
    color = max(figure_colors, key=lambda c: counts[c])
    return [[color] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
